title: Minimum Required Window
summary: Find the shortest substring covering a character multiset.
statement: Return the shortest substring of `text` containing every character of `required` with multiplicity. Return the earliest on ties and empty when impossible.
hints: Expand until every required character count is satisfied.
Track how many distinct required counts are currently complete.
Once complete, move the left edge while preserving validity and record improvements.
Two moving boundaries plus frequency maps give linear time.
editorial: Use a frequency-aware sliding window. Expand to become valid, then shrink greedily to find the smallest valid window.

tests.explanation: 'BANC' is the shortest substring containing A, B, and C.
The source lacks two copies of 'a', so no valid window exists.
